text: Actual-binary evidence advanced without overclaiming: official Slurm 25.05.6 built in a disposable controller, advertised data_parser/v0.0.43, accepted a harmless 2-element serial array, and emitted the compressed pending-array record. Exact stdout/version/parser-list bytes and provenance live under modules/cli/src/test/resources/fixtures/slurm-25.05.6-v0.0.43-actual; parser replay verifies bounded element matching, cluster metadata, stream byte counts, and SHA-256 on Scala 3.3.8 and 3.8.4 (17 CLI tests each). Worker registration failed, so no execution/accounting/site support is claimed. Environment approval denied the 26.05 image build, and Trillium remains unauthenticated. P5 stays open for second actual major-family evidence plus real unprivileged-site acceptance; optional REST remains unadmitted.
